title: AI Observability and Cost
description: Single Azure Monitor dashboard for model usage, reliability, attribution, guardrails, MCP activity, billed cost, budget, export state, and resource inventory.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName startswith "ai-observability-demo-apim-"
| where Name has "/models/" or Name has "/agent-model/"
| summarize Requests = count()

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName startswith "ai-observability-demo-apim-"
| where Name has "/models/" or Name has "/agent-model/"
| summarize Requests = count(), SuccessfulRequests = countif(Success == true)
| project SuccessRate = iff(Requests == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * SuccessfulRequests / Requests, 2))

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName startswith "ai-observability-demo-apim-"
| where Name has "/models/" or Name has "/agent-model/"
| summarize P95Milliseconds = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0)

AppMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| summarize Tokens = tolong(sum(Sum))

panels.title: Month-to-date billed cost (billing currency)
panels.description: Latest managed-identity Cost Management actual-cost snapshot.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let LatestSnapshot = toscalar(AIObservabilityCostDaily_CL | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, SnapshotId) | project SnapshotId);
AIObservabilityCostDaily_CL
| where SnapshotId == LatestSnapshot
| summarize ActualCost = round(sum(ActualCost), 2)

AIObservabilityFinOpsState_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *)
| project PercentConsumed

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName startswith "ai-observability-demo-apim-"
| where Name has "/models/" or Name has "/agent-model/"
| extend Model = iff(Name has "/claude/", "claude-opus-5", "gpt-5.4")
| summarize Requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Model
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Token trend by model and team

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Team = tostring(Properties["Team"])
| summarize Tokens = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Model, Team
| order by TimeGenerated asc

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName startswith "ai-observability-demo-apim-"
| where Name has "/models/" or Name has "/agent-model/"
| extend Model = iff(Name has "/claude/", "claude-opus-5", "gpt-5.4")
| summarize P95Milliseconds = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Model
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Token composition
panels.description: Standard APIM token metrics. Prompt Cached Tokens is a subset of prompt tokens, and reasoning is a subset of completion tokens. The chart separates cached input and reasoning output without double counting.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let Totals = AppMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Completion Reasoning Tokens")
| summarize
    Prompt = sumif(Sum, Name == "Prompt Tokens"),
    CachedInput = sumif(Sum, Name == "Prompt Cached Tokens"),
    Completion = sumif(Sum, Name == "Completion Tokens"),
    Reasoning = sumif(Sum, Name == "Completion Reasoning Tokens");
union
(Totals | project TokenType = "Uncached input", Tokens = tolong(max_of(Prompt - CachedInput, 0.0))),
(Totals | where CachedInput > 0 | project TokenType = "Cached input", Tokens = tolong(CachedInput)),
(Totals | project TokenType = "Visible output", Tokens = tolong(max_of(Completion - Reasoning, 0.0))),
(Totals | where Reasoning > 0 | project TokenType = "Reasoning output", Tokens = tolong(Reasoning))
| where Tokens > 0
| order by TokenType asc

AppMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend Team = tostring(Properties["Team"]), User = tostring(Properties["User"]), Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Project = tostring(Properties["Project"])
| summarize Requests = tolong(sum(ItemCount)), Tokens = tolong(sum(Sum)) by Team, User, Model, Project
| order by Tokens desc

AppDependencies
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName startswith "ai-observability-demo-apim-" or AppRoleName startswith "ai-observability-demo-web-"
| summarize Calls = count(), Failures = countif(Success == false), P95Milliseconds = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0) by AppRoleName, Name, Target
| order by Calls desc

panels.title: Guardrail outcomes
panels.description: Application decisions plus APIM Prompt Shield blocks and direct protected-code checks.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let ApplicationDecisions = AppEvents
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Name == "guardrail.decision"
| extend Guardrail = tostring(Properties["guardrail"]), Stage = tostring(Properties["stage"]), Outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"])
| project TimeGenerated, Source = "Application", Guardrail, Stage, Outcome;
let GatewayDecisions = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where (ApiId == "openai-model-api" and LastErrorSource == "llm-content-safety" and LastErrorMessage has "attack detected") or ApiId == "protected-code-api"
| extend Guardrail = iff(ApiId == "protected-code-api", "protected_material_code", "prompt_shield"), Stage = iff(ApiId == "protected-code-api", "direct_check", "request"), Outcome = case(ApiId == "protected-code-api" and ResponseCode between (200 .. 299), "executed", ApiId == "openai-model-api" and ResponseCode == 403, "blocked", "failed")
| project TimeGenerated, Source = "APIM", Guardrail, Stage, Outcome;
union ApplicationDecisions, GatewayDecisions
| summarize Events = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Source, Guardrail, Stage, Outcome
| order by LastSeen desc

panels.title: Billed cost by day and service
panels.description: Latest Cost Management actual-cost snapshot. Billing data is delayed and can be rerated.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let LatestSnapshot = toscalar(AIObservabilityCostDaily_CL | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, SnapshotId) | project SnapshotId);
AIObservabilityCostDaily_CL
| where SnapshotId == LatestSnapshot
| summarize ActualCost = sum(ActualCost) by UsageDate, ServiceName
| order by UsageDate asc

let LatestSnapshot = toscalar(AIObservabilityCostDaily_CL | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, SnapshotId) | project SnapshotId);
AIObservabilityCostDaily_CL
| where SnapshotId == LatestSnapshot
| summarize ActualCost = round(sum(ActualCost), 2) by ServiceName
| order by ActualCost desc

AIObservabilityFinOpsState_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *)
| project TimeGenerated, BudgetAmount, CurrentSpend, Currency, PercentConsumed = round(PercentConsumed, 2), NotificationRecipientsConfigured, ExportScheduleStatus, ExportLastRunStatus, ExportLastRunTime, ExportFormat, ExportCompression, ExportPartitioned, ExportManifestPath

ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Url has "/models/" or Url has "/agent-model/" or Url has "/agents/weather/" or Url has "/guardrails/"
| extend Route = tostring(parse_url(Url).Path)
| summarize Requests = count(), Successes = countif(ResponseCode between (200 .. 399)), Failures = countif(ResponseCode >= 400), P95Milliseconds = round(percentile(TotalTime, 95), 0) by Route, ResponseCode
| order by Requests desc

AzureDiagnostics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.COGNITIVESERVICES"
| summarize Rows = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Category
| order by Rows desc

let LatestSnapshot = toscalar(AIObservabilityResourceInventory_CL | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, SnapshotId) | project SnapshotId);
AIObservabilityResourceInventory_CL
| where SnapshotId == LatestSnapshot
| project ResourceName, ResourceType, Location, Tags
| order by ResourceType asc, ResourceName asc

panels.title: MCP activity by method
panels.description: APIM GatewayMCPLogs emitted by the APIM Azure Monitor diagnostic setting.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Method)
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Method
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: MCP tools and errors
panels.description: Tool calls and errors from APIM GatewayMCPLogs, grouped by MCP server, tool, method, and transport.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Method == "tools/call" or isnotempty(Error) or isnotempty(ErrorType)
| summarize Events = count(), Errors = countif(isnotempty(Error) or isnotempty(ErrorType)), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Sessions = dcountif(SessionId, isnotempty(SessionId)), ProtocolVersions = make_set_if(ProtocolVersion, isnotempty(ProtocolVersion), 5) by McpServerEndpoint, ToolName, Method, TransportType
| order by LastSeen desc

panels.title: Quota responses, quality, and freshness
panels.description: ReviewCount shows records that need attention: quota responses, failed gateway requests, missing attribution values, or a non-completed export state. Zero means that the signal has no detected review item.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union
(AppRequests | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Records = count(), ReviewCount = countif(ResultCode == "429") | project Signal = "Application requests", LastSeen, Records, ReviewCount),
(AppMetrics | where Name == "Total Tokens" | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Records = tolong(sum(ItemCount)), ReviewCount = countif(isempty(tostring(Properties["Team"])) or isempty(tostring(Properties["User"])) or isempty(tostring(Properties["Model"]))) | project Signal = "Token attribution", LastSeen, Records, ReviewCount),
(ApiManagementGatewayLogs | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Records = count(), ReviewCount = countif(ResponseCode >= 400) | project Signal = "APIM gateway", LastSeen, Records, ReviewCount),
(ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Records = count(), ReviewCount = countif(isnotempty(Error) or isnotempty(ErrorType)) | project Signal = "APIM MCP", LastSeen, Records, ReviewCount),
(AIObservabilityCostDaily_CL | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Records = count(), ReviewCount = 0 | project Signal = "Cost snapshot", LastSeen, Records, ReviewCount),
(AIObservabilityFinOpsState_CL | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Records = count(), ReviewCount = countif(ExportLastRunStatus != "Completed") | project Signal = "Budget and export state", LastSeen, Records, ReviewCount)
| order by Signal asc
